title: Competitive Signal Funnel and Prioritization Playbook for Model Trajectories
creator: Ava Patel
description: Create a repeatable playbook that transforms raw competitive signals about open and commercial model trajectories into prioritized product and go-to-market initiatives. This ticket captures signal sources, scoring rules, decision gates, tooling recommendations, and an operational cadence for PM/Research to hand off clear requests to Engineering and Design.
signal_sources: Open-source model repo activity (GitHub stars, commits, PRs)
Model leaderboard benchmarks (latency, throughput, accuracy on CoreEval)
License/eco events (new permissive license releases, license changes)
Community & adoption metrics (huggingface downloads, colab notebooks)
Cloud provider model offerings and pricing changes
Customer support tickets and sales intelligence
scoring_rubric: Signals scored 0-100 across five dimensions: Momentum (repo + downloads), Technical Delta (benchmarks vs baseline), Production-readiness Risk (licensing + infra needs), Strategic Fit (maps to one of our OKRs), and Commercial Impact (estimated $/monthly CCU impact). Weighting defaults: Momentum 20%, Technical Delta 25%, Risk 15%, Fit 20%, Commercial 20%.
prioritization_algorithm: Aggregate weighted score produces Tier 1/2/3 buckets. Tiers map to action: Tier 1 -> immediate spike evaluation (benchmarks + quick integration test) and PM-ENG spike; Tier 2 -> monitor + add to quarterly roadmap queue; Tier 3 -> archive with monthly re-check. Tie-breakers: regulatory/licensing constraints, existing customer ask, and synergy with runtime optimization roadmap.

2026-01-10: Pilot applied to 12 candidate models from OSS and two commercial offerings; produced three Tier 1 candidates

2026-02-12: Ran batch evaluations for 8 OSS models; observed strong correlation between Momentum and Community Adoption metrics
2026-03-05: Adjusted Commercial Impact calculation after sales feedback; now uses ARR-weighted customer interest instead of raw mentions
